description: Kep is known for fresh crab market and peaceful sea views.
Sunset at Kep beach is popular for romantic trips.
Angkor temples provide rich cultural and historical experiences.
There are many family-friendly activities and guided tours.
Mondulkiri has cool weather, mountains, and forest landscapes.
It is a strong option for quiet, solo nature travel.
Phnom Penh has modern malls, restaurants, and nightlife.
It suits energetic weekend trips with friends.
